title: Beef keema with cabbage and cavolo nero

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain home staple, and curry powder, tinned tomatoes and natural yoghurt are all ordinary cupboard and fridge items.

supermarket.reason: Beef mince, white cabbage, cavolo nero and the rest are everyday items at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large lidded casserole and simple browning and simmering.

works.reason: 500g mince and 500g potatoes with half a cabbage feed four, the potatoes get about 25 minutes of simmering, and a tin of tomatoes plus 300ml water is a sensible amount of liquid.

honest_times.reason: Chopping two onions, cubing potatoes and shredding cabbage, then browning and softening, fits roughly 25 minutes active, and the 15 plus 12 minute covered simmers sit close to the 35 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming spiced one-pot suits early March, and half a white cabbage is a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling family dinner of mince, potatoes and plenty of greens with a yoghurt finish.
